summary: Implemented unknown-total (None) Progress tasks across rich/progress.py, rich/progress_bar.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and tests/test_progress.py. Added TaskProgressColumn (TextColumn subclass, exported from rich.progress) and made Task, ProgressBar, BarColumn, TimeRemainingColumn, TotalFileSizeColumn, MofNCompleteColumn, and DownloadColumn handle a None total. Default and track columns now use TaskProgressColumn. Added tests for blank, "?", binary-unit outputs, unknown-total task state, finish after update(total=...), and an exact pulse snapshot render. tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_bar.py pass (53/53). Full suite: the same 13 syntax/markdown/card/traceback tests fail with and without the change; tests/test_pretty.py fails at collection with an ImportError I did not check against the base tree. black is not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was done by hand. Nothing committed.
